title: Major Mountain Ranges
text: The Himalayas, spanning across India, Nepal, Bhutan, and China, contain the world's highest peaks, including Mount Everest at 8,849 meters, and formed from the collision of the Indian and Eurasian tectonic plates. The Andes, running along the western edge of South America, form the longest continental mountain range in the world. Other major ranges include the Rockies (North America) and the Alps (Europe).
